scenes.text: Imagine standing in a spot where you could commit the perfect crime and legally walk away free.
In a fifty-square-mile section of Yellowstone National Park, this isn't just a movie plot—it's a real constitutional loophole called the Zone of Death.
Because of a strange overlap in federal law, a jury must be selected from the local population, but absolutely nobody lives in this specific uninhabited strip.
Would you ever camp in a place where the law literally doesn't exist? Drop a comment below and follow for more mind-blowing facts!
